name: citeanything
description: Create replayable evidence citations and cite private knowledge-base documents from AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Turn inspected evidence into replayable citations
interface.longDescription: Use the host agent's own web tools to inspect original sources, then create replayable CiteAnything citations with automatic preview screenshots. Search and cite private knowledge-base documents and publish cited articles without adding another web-search provider.
defaultPrompt: Research this question and make every important factual claim verifiable with CiteAnything
Create replayable citations for the evidence I already inspected
Search my CiteAnything knowledge base and answer with exact cited evidence
